_how: NFL firsts shown on the stats page, newest first. The live copy is on the stats-data branch (edit there to add one without a Netlify deploy); this copy on main is the fallback.

items.text: First player in NFL history to pass for 200+ yards on fewer than 20 attempts and run for 100+ yards on 10 or fewer carries in the same game.
First quarterback in NFL history with a rushing touchdown in each of his team's first five games of a season.
First quarterback in NFL history to run for two touchdowns in each of the first three games of a season.
First quarterback in NFL history to complete 80% of his passes and run for multiple touchdowns in a playoff game.
Only player in NFL history with a season of 25+ passing TDs and 12+ rushing TDs, and he has done it three times.
Became the NFL's all-time leader in rushing touchdowns by a quarterback, passing Cam Newton's 75.
Only player in NFL history with more than one game of 3+ passing TDs and 3+ rushing TDs.
First player in NFL history with 250+ passing yards and 2+ rushing TDs in a single quarter.
First player in NFL history with five straight seasons of 40+ total touchdowns (2020-24).
First quarterback in NFL history with 350+ passing yards, 60+ rushing yards, 2+ passing TDs and 2+ rushing TDs in one game (playoffs included).
items.line: 362 yds, 2 passing TDs · 68 rushing yds, 2 rushing TDs

items.text: First player in NFL history with 2+ passing TDs and 2+ rushing TDs in back-to-back games, and later the first with three such games in one season.
First player in NFL history with three passing TDs and three rushing TDs in a regular-season game.
items.line: 342 yds, 3 passing TDs · 82 rushing yds, 3 rushing TDs

items.text: First quarterback in NFL history with a passing, rushing and receiving touchdown in the same game.
items.line: 2 passing TDs · 1 rushing TD · 1 receiving TD

items.text: First quarterback in NFL history with 6+ rushing TDs in seven straight seasons (2018-24).
First quarterback in NFL history with 300 passing yards, 60 rushing yards and five passing TDs in a playoff game.

items.game: Week 18 vs. Jets, end of 2021 season
items.text: First player in NFL history to throw for 4,000 yards and run for 750 in the same season.
